verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Registrar is a domain registration and renewal service. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user-built automations is outside what a registrar does. The evidence covers only an auto-renew toggle and a Registrar API for managing domains, neither of which is a versioned automation system, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
